mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT asin FROM competitor_products WHERE marketplace = #{marketplace} AND asin IN #{a} UNION SELECT DISTINCT parent_asin FROM competitor_products WHERE marketplace = #{marketplace} AND parent_asin IS NOT NULL AND parent_asin != '' AND parent_asin IN #{a}

SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(parent_asin, ''), asin) AS dedupKey, COUNT(*) AS variantCount FROM competitor_products WHERE marketplace = #{marketplace} AND title IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(NULLIF(parent_asin, ''), asin) IN #{k} GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(parent_asin, ''), asin)
